title: drynaria quercifolia var. normalis
intro: Drynaria quercifolia var. normalis, commonly known as the 'Rhinoceros Hornbill's Pride', is a type of plant in the Polypodiaceae family. It is a species of fern that has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. Drynaria quercifolia var. normalis is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of immune modulation, anti-coagulation, and anti-platelet aggregation.
